scenarios.clean_verified: Apollo high-confidence match with a verified email; not in CRM
scenarios.email_unverified: Apollo returns an unverified email; Hunter verifies it
scenarios.email_unavailable: Apollo has no email for the person: lead by name + LinkedIn
scenarios.apollo_no_match: Apollo match_confidence 'none': only the masked search hit
scenarios.low_confidence_hit: Apollo 'low' confidence answer to an id lookup
scenarios.hubspot_opted_out: HubSpot hs_email_optout=true: lead opted out and suppressed
scenarios.hubspot_open_deal: HubSpot contact with an open deal (hs_is_closed=false)
scenarios.hubspot_known_clean: HubSpot contact exists, opted in, no open deal
scenarios.hubspot_additional_email: HubSpot finds the address via hs_additional_emails; primary email differs
scenarios.hubspot_duplicate_contacts: Two HubSpot contacts share the address, one opted out: fail closed
scenarios.role_address: Apollo's verified email is a role inbox (info@, sales@ ...)
scenarios.shared_address: Two different people reported with the same address
scenarios.listed_under_two_technologies: One Apollo id in two technology searches
scenarios.duplicate_apollo_records: Two Apollo ids for one person (same LinkedIn, same verified email)
scenarios.duplicate_with_domain_conflict: Duplicate Apollo records whose companies name different primary domains
scenarios.name_collision: Two people with the same name at the same company
scenarios.oversized_title: A 5,000-character title: bounded as untrusted text
scenarios.prompt_injection_title: A title carrying instructions: stored as plain text
scenarios.hunter_found_email: Apollo has no email; Hunter's finder finds a valid one
scenarios.hunter_invalid: Apollo says verified; Hunter's verifier says invalid
scenarios.hunter_accept_all: Apollo says verified; Hunter says the domain accepts all
scenarios.hunter_claimed_email: Hunter answers 451: the person asked not to be processed
scenarios.hunter_smtp_failure: Hunter answers 222 (SMTP failure): Apollo's status stands
